messages:
kelly_support: FYI — MediSync just uploaded a full security/compliance questionnaire. They marked SOC2 + HIPAA + GDPR as applicable. Link: https://files.medisync/qna-2026.pdf :eyes:

dylan_sales: they want answers before contract signature next week, asking for a security packet + BAA. high commercial pressure.

ajay: can someone paste the critical questions or highlights here? we should triage by impact and whether it's an ask we can answer with existing docs.

maria_p: pasted the PDF header and table of contents — main asks: control matrix for SOC2, audit log retention and export formats, encryption at rest/key mgmt, data residency, BAA clauses, breach notification timelines, processing purposes for GDPR.

compliance-bot: Automated classification: Priority=HIGH; Regimes=[SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR]; Suggested owners=[security:maria_p, legal:legal_sara, product:ajay]; Estimated ticket type=Documentation+Policy.

product_lead_emma: ok. proposed triage: 1) Bundle a "security packet" (SOC2 control descriptions, artifacts list, audit log schema + retention policy) as an immediate deliverable. 2) Legal to draft/confirm BAA + exportable DPA for GDPR. 3) HIPAA-specific operational details to follow (BAA sign + deployment controls).

kelly_support: customer expects an initial packet by EOW next Friday. can we realistically do that?

sam_irving: to scope eng work — audit log export already exists (S3 JSON with timestamp, user_id, request_id). retention currently configurable per-tenant but UI only; backend retention job runs daily. likely a few days to produce docs + sample export.

ajay: acceptance criteria for "security packet" (so product can sign off):
- SOC2: narrative for each relevant Trust Services criterion we map to + list of artifacts (logs, configs, policy docs)
- Audit logs: schema example, retention policy, how to request export, encryption details
- GDPR: data processing purpose + data subject support flow (deletion/portability)
- HIPAA: interim operational controls summary and BAA pointer (legal to confirm)
If those are present, product can mark packet as "sufficient for pre-sales".

legal_sara: I'll start a draft BAA and DPA template. need to confirm retention windows we offer (30/90/365 days) and someone to own signatures.

maria_p: security will prepare the SOC2 control mapping and sample artifact list. ETA 4 business days for a first pass.

ajay: we should create a minimal intake record in Jira so we can track commitments. fields: question, regime, severity, owner, required_by, proposed_scope, deliverable_type. example JSON snippet for the intake we can paste in the ticket:

```json
{
  "question": "MediSync questionnaire - SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR summary",
  "regime": "SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR",
  "severity": "high",
  "owner": "ajay (product)",
  "required_by": "1753600000",
  "proposed_scope": "Security packet (SOC2 narratives, audit logs export + retention, DPA/BAA draft)",
  "deliverable_type": "docs+templates"
}
```

dylan_sales: please include a short cover note we can send to the customer saying "initial packet provides control narratives + artifacts; BAA/DPA in progress; HIPAA operational details to follow". that buys time.

ajay: agreed — product will assemble the packet. plan: create Jira ticket P1, assign to maria_p + legal_sara, sam for engineering artifacts, deliver initial packet (pdf + sample logs) in 5 business days, BAA/DPA in parallel. if legal/engineering need more time, escalate.

kelly_support: I'll update the customer with that timeline now.

sam_irving: quick ask for eng owners — what exact retention windows should we document? legal_sara?

legal_sara: confirm we can offer 30/90/365 as standard options; custom retention requires legal approval.

ajay: next steps: 1) kelly_support update customer; 2) ajay create Jira intake + attach PDF; 3) maria_p produce SOC2 mapping + artifact list; 4) sam_irving export sample logs + add retention config doc; 5) legal_sara draft BAA/DPA. check-in in 3 days. :calendar:

kelly_support: done — customer updated, they acknowledged and said thanks. :thumbsup:
